_meta.note: Deterministic: same seed, same fixture, same output. No network and no LLM calls. Pricing comes from agents/pricing, the same module the live agents use.

agents.label: Longrun
agents.thesis: Every season since 1981 counts equally; the climate is noise around a mean.

agents.label: Recent
agents.thesis: Only the last 15 seasons tell you anything; the old ones are a different climate.

agents.label: Blend
agents.thesis: Split the difference and charge a little more for not knowing which is right.

agents.label: Cautious
agents.thesis: Price the worse of the two views. Survive first, compete second.

agents.label: Capacity
agents.thesis: Blend the views, then ration the last of the capital by charging more for it.
